A '''starship''' from the [[Jedi Civil War]] was acquired by a [[Unidentified scrap dealer|scrap dealer]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and the scrap dealer unsuccessfully tried to sell it as the [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|''Leviathan'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Darth Malak]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Wake the Leviathan}}</ref>
